'''Kiyoshi''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Gray Ajah]]. 

==Appearance and Personality==
She is tall and slender.

She is a stickler for punctuality and neatness.

==Activities==
She remained loyal to the [[White Tower]] during the split.

[[Alviarin Freidhen]] suggests that [[Elaida a'Roihan]] reward her, along with [[Farellien]] and [[Doraise Mesianos]], while simultaneously punishing [[Josaine]] and [[Adelorna Bastine]], who held objects of the [[One Power]] without the Tower's permission or knowledge. This would imply that one of the three had informed on those that were punished, thereby creating strife among the Ajahs{{Ref/book|7|32}}.

[[Egwene al'Vere]] is late for a lesson with Kiyoshi after being sent for punishment by [[Cariandre Temalien]]. She didn't have any time for brushing her hair or changing her damp clothes before the lesson. Kiyoshi sends her to [[Silviana Brehon]] again for being untidy and late.
